description: This is a Java source file implementing the AddressReadPlatformService interface. It provides methods to retrieve address data from a database, including search and filter functionalities, and uses Spring's JdbcTemplate for database access.

classes.name: AddFieldsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to AddressData objects with address fields.

classes.name: AddMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set to AddressData objects including address metadata and related codes.

methods.name: retrieveAddressFields
methods.description: Retrieves address fields for a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientAddress
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyType
methods.description: Retrieves addresses of a specific type for a given client.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves addresses of a specific type and status for a client.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves addresses with a specific active/inactive status for a client.

methods.name: retrieveBySearchParam
methods.description: Retrieves addresses based on search parameters, applying filter rules.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template AddressData object with options for country, state, and address types.

methods.name: getFilterRules
methods.description: Defines filtering logic for different search scenarios based on search parameters.
